origin.description: Draw a bar sparkline from numbers between 0 and 1.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Numbers from 0 to 1. Missing values become spaces.

origin.details: UTF-8 output uses the eight block characters from U+2581. Otherwise the characters are underscore, comma, star, and hash. cut() include.lowest puts the lowest break in the first bin.

translation.description: Draw a bar sparkline from numbers between 0 and 1.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Numbers from 0 to 1. Missing values become spaces.

translation.example:
from cli import options, spark_bar
options(**{"cli.unicode": True})
print(spark_bar([i / 5 for i in range(6)]))
